liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Visions of Johanna** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the first-set version a crown jewel; Reviewer calls it the greatest version, among only eight performances, with Garcia sounding especially good [12][19]
- **Promised Land** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer says it had the crowd rocking hard; Supposedly all DATs have it cut; this is one of few copies where it is intact [4][12]
- **Days Between** (2 reviews): Reviewer found it very emotional and shed a tear during it; Reviewer hears it as Garcia signing off, noting his own apocalypse [10][15]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Reviewer calls it an excellent 1990s version opening the second set, with strong jams [8]
- **Corinna** (1 review): Reviewer praises Garcia's harmonizer solo as one of his best ever [14]
- **Drums** (1 review): Mickey and Bill play an unusual beat in the middle of the segment [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Visions of Johanna**: rare: 10 archived performances [20]
- **NFA chant/crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-04-07.fob.schoeps.clete.92108.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 172 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd95-04-07.sbd.7688.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 167 min; rated 3.51/5 by 55 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the recording quality highly [11]
- **gd1995-04-07.sbd.larson.tetzeli.fix-35148.35364.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 169 min; rated 2.43/5 by 14 [4]
- **gd1995-04-07.sbd.larson.35148.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 169 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says it was the last time they caught the band before the end [8]
- Reviewer's seats were so poor they might as well have been in the parking lot [9]
- Reviewer says this was the final show of the Spring 1995 tour [10]
- Reviewer's wife attended and said the Black Crows left a bad impression from the start [11]
- Stadium was very loud; at setbreak a person behind the reviewer fainted from overdoing drugs [12]
- Reviewer interviewed Mickey Hart about his Library of Congress world music project; story ran page one that day [13]
- It was the reviewer's first Grateful Dead show, at age 15 [19]
- Reviewer ranks it a good show but not among the best of 1995 [9]
- Reviewer saw Unbroken Chain with new effects compared with Charlotte a couple of weeks earlier [10]
- Reviewer finds Garcia's playing weak, with Weir seeming to hold him up [11]
- Reviewer considers the March 23, 1995 Days Between the best version, better than this one [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-04-07.fob.schoeps.clete.92108.flac16**: taped by Clete; transferred by Chris Davis; source: (fob) Scheops cmc6/mk4v (unknown pre-amp/recorder) [1]
- **gd95-04-07.sbd.7688.sbeok.shnf**: source: Source unknown - suspect SBD> ?> CDR> EAC> SHN [2]. Also: Reviewer claims to be the likely original source of the recording, working at the St. Petersburg Times; Source unknown, suspected soundboard to CDR to EAC to SHN, likely via cassette; from JT James [2][13]
- **gd1995-04-07.sbd.larson.tetzeli.fix-35148.35364.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD>Cass>DAT>ZA2>Samlitude2496(WAV)>SHN>WAV>FLAC [4]. Also: Bill Tetzeli fixed the transition between discs two and three [4]
- **gd1995-04-07.sbd.larson.35148.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: SBD>?>Cass>DAT [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Tampa 1995](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/tampa-1995) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Tampa Stadium Tapers Section 04/07/95](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/tampa-stadium-tapers-section-04-07-95) [22]
- Poster by Scott Hopkins: [Last Trip to Tampa: Grateful Dead 04.07.95 • MUSICFESTNEWS](https://www.musicfestnews.com/2025/04/last-trip-to-tampa-grateful-dead-04-07-95/) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead ticket stub 04/07/95 tampa stadium](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/ticket-stub-04-07-95-tampa-stadium) [24]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1995-04-07 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1995-04-07-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [25]
